temporal_capture.contract: Intersect metadata with subject/entity predicates before retaining IDs or copying reverse edges; retain incoming edges from superseders outside scope. Unfiltered subject/entity queries use their postings.

resource_limit.contract: QueryLimitExceeded::CODE is resource_limit; native Node prefix and MemoryError code, HTTP 429 problem and legacy code; no partial answer or Retry-After; committed errors retain priority.
